audit.whatIsWrong: Crystallize was labelled (E) in wants.foe[1] and "the wall (E)" in spikes[2].text. Crystallize is W; E is Frostbite.
audit.why: Riot's slots: Q Flash Frost, W Crystallize (impassable wall of ice, 17s, 1000 range), E Frostbite (650 range, 4s), R Glacial Storm. The packet flagged this as a suspect name and it is a real one.
audit.corrected: Both relabelled (W). The rest of the page's letters were checked and are correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Rebirth sustain" appears in whys[4], spikes[2].text, content.late and wants.foe[2] — as if Rebirth were a heal or drain Anivia stacks up.
audit.why: Rebirth is not sustain. On fatal damage she reverts to an egg and is reborn at full health. The correct advice is completely different: every kill costs two health bars, and you have to break the egg with soldier autos before you walk away.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten around the egg, not around imaginary sustain; ahead now tells the reader to burn the egg.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction in this lane was never stated: Frostbite's damage DOUBLES only if the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm.
audit.why: Riot's E text says exactly that. It turns "dodge the sphere" from generic advice into a damage number, and it is why standing in Glacial Storm is unaffordable.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d, phases[1].why, phases[4].why, whys[4] and enemyWin.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..2].side read "Skill" against content win[0..2]="Azir", and phases[4].side read "Skill" against content win[4]="Anivia" — four rows rendering two answers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart agrees with content (Azir, Azir, Azir, Skill, Anivia, Azir, Skill) and Azir's 51.75% supports an early lead: his soldier reach beats a 1075-range sphere that travels slowly on 11s, and Frostbite at 650 range cannot reach him without the Flash Frost proc. At 6 Glacial Storm holds ground and doubles Frostbite, which is a real flip to Anivia.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side to Azir at 4/10, phases[4].side to Anivia (rating already 6/10), each with its why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text said "your R can reposition soldiers around it".
audit.why: Emperor's Divide summons a charging wall; it does not move Sand Soldiers. Arise! places them and Shifting Sands/Q move them.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to name Arise! and Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flagged "NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere", sequencingCues was 0, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (catalogue defect 3).
audit.why: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7 at 80-100 mana, Crystallize 17s flat at 1000 range, Frostbite 4s flat, Azir E 22s at rank 1, Azir Q 14s at rank 1 costing 110 at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Real numbers and explicit sequencing written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0..2].d, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave and phases[0..2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anivia was called he/his across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, phases[3].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].t, breakdown.trading and reports 0, 1, 3, 4.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists anivia as female; the owner is "you", so every third-person pronoun is Anivia.
audit.corrected: All swapped to she/her at matching length.

notes: Two systemic errors here, both repeated across four or five fields each: Crystallize labelled (E) when it is W, and Rebirth described as "sustain" she stacks up. Rebirth is the egg — it changes the advice completely (kill her twice, break the egg) and the page was telling the reader the opposite kind of thing. Level chart: four full-layer rows disagreed with content and packet, which agreed with each other; I moved all four with their whys and ratings. Note the phases[5] row (First item, side Azir) carries rating 6/10 while the rows I set for an Azir-favoured stage read 4/10 — I left phases[5].rating alone rather than churn a row I was not otherwise touching. breakdown.late left as generic Azir boilerplate; nothing specific to Anivia I can source for it.
